question.text: Off-setting of positions for leverage calculation is allowed:

answer.text: In accordance with SEBI norms for hedging and portfolio rebalancing

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 8.2.2, offsetting is permitted only in accordance with SEBI norms for hedging and portfolio rebalancing — not freely across different securities. The Trap: Free off-setting or never-off-setting are extremes not matching reality. Cross-Exam Context: Important distinction for compliance. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Keep detailed records of which positions are off-set and regulatory basis for each.
